summary: This is a routine adjournment of an extraordinary general meeting for Graf Global Corp., a blank-check company. The filing reports that at the scheduled June 26, 2026 meeting, shareholders approved a proposal to adjourn to later that same day at 3:00 p.m. to continue seeking approval of an extension of the deadline to consummate a business combination. No special situation is triggered; it is a procedural step common to SPACs. There are no deal terms, prices, advisors, or structural changes to analyze. What to watch: the outcome of the extension vote and any redemptions at the reconvened meeting.
